title: Gold Reworked
description: Gold gear is too weak he need a fix
body:
✨ Gold Reworked

Gold Reworked transforms golden equipment from fragile, useless items into powerful, strategic end-game gear. Don't throw away your gold anymore—become a true gilded conqueror!

🛡️ Key Features
💎 Infinite Durability

Golden armor no longer breaks! As long as you wear the full set your equipment automatically repairs itself every second,(in 1.3+ gold consume xp for auto repairing).


🧪 Effect Stabilizer

The armor acts as a magical catalyst. If you already have a potion effect active (Speed, Strength, Resistance,..,except regeneration/absorption/poison/wither), wearing the full set will maintain the effect indefinitely as long as you keep the armor on.

    Note: The armor doesn't give free effects; it stabilizes the ones you already
    have!
    
🔱 Goldens Weapons in 1.2+ :

    Every 5 levels goldens weapons does 0.5 more damages (example +4.5 damages in
    30 levels)    

Note : 1.0 version of this datapack don't work on servers
